items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: LinearSolveBench, interesting new benchmark to discover linear solvers
items.contentSnippet:
LinearSolveBench measures the ability of a model or harness to write fast, accurate, and general numerical solvers for large sparse linear systems in C.
The goal is to encourage algorithmic advances in numerical solvers for linear systems of equations.

items.title: The Creolisation of Recognition
items.contentSnippet: What if our recognition systems are still doing the quiet work of colonization, even when they claim inclusion? Simone Ravaioli of Instructure explores creolization as a generative framework for redesigning how we validate learning across cultural and epistemological borders. Drawing on thinkers like Tyson Yunkaporta and Serge Ravet, this piece challenges education leaders to move beyond Recognition of Prior Learning toward relational protocols that let different knowledge systems meet as equals
